name: firebreak
description: Firebreak — commit-time and PR-time cost review for Claude Code

plugins.name: firebreak
plugins.description: Reviews a change set for runaway cost and irreversible real-world harm — a metered operation reachable with no working upper bound — and reports in money rather than severity words. Three surfaces: the working tree before a commit, a branch or PR under review, and a headless CI gate. Carries a money-sink catalog of observed provider unit costs (Twilio, Stripe, Anthropic, OpenAI, SES/SendGrid, S3, Maps, Algolia, Cloudflare, Mixpanel) and a review method built from a real incident. Reports; never edits.
